title: Paxa Recognizer Options
description: Paxa Labs realtime STT options. Only applies when recognizer vendor is 'paxa'. Paxa detects the end of each turn and produces one final transcript per turn. The recognizer language is sent as a hint (it never filters out other languages); set it to 'any' for automatic detection.

style.description: verbatim (default) keeps fillers and false starts; clean drops them.

convention.description: spoken (default) writes numbers as said; written uses digits and units.
